The "focus on OBJ" action is extremely critical and should not be used to look at or shift your attention to a specific object. It should only be used as described in the task description. Using this action inappropriately will result in task failure. The "wait" action is used to wait for time to pass during tasks that require the passage of time.
Templates:
	read OBJ
	activate OBJ
	deactivate OBJ
	open OBJ
	close OBJ
	pick up OBJ
	look in OBJ
	focus on OBJ
	move OBJ to CONTAINER
	pour OBJ in CONTAINER
	mix CONTAINER
	teleport LOCATION
	go LOCATION
	wait
steps.task_description:
Task Description:
Your task is to use chemistry to create the substance 'banana sandwich'. A recipe and some of the ingredients might be found near the kitchen. When you are done, focus on the banana sandwich.
